## Overview

This example shows the smallest useful Quarto Manual in practice.

The operator's goal is simple: connect a registered dataset into a project
workspace in a reproducible way.

The manual therefore stays small:

- a cover page explains the purpose of data staging;
- a helper page provides shared context;
- one workflow page performs and checks the staging step.

This is the kind of manual a researcher might keep close at hand and rerun
whenever a new project needs the same setup.
